mapper.select: SELECT CHATROOM_ID AS chatroomId, CHATUSER1_ID AS chatuser1Id, CHATUSER2_ID AS chatuser2Id, REQUESTED_BY AS requestedBy, CHATROOM_STATUS AS chatroomStatus, UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt, CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM TTM.CHATROOMS WHERE (CHATUSER1_ID = #{userId} OR CHATUSER2_ID = #{userId}) AND CHATROOM_STATUS IN ('A','P') ORDER BY NVL(UPDATED_AT, CREATED_AT) DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CHATROOMS( CHATROOM_ID, CHATUSER1_ID, CHATUSER2_ID, REQUESTED_BY, CHATROOM_STATUS, UPDATED_AT, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_CHATROOMS_CHATROOM_ID.NEXTVAL, #{chatuser1Id}, #{chatuser2Id}, #{requestedBy}, #{chatroomStatus}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE CHATROOMS SET CHATROOM_STATUS = #{status}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE CHATROOM_ID = #{roomId}
